messages:
Rina Kapoor: Heads up: Invoice from NimbusCloud INV-2026-11-033 for $9,120 landed with no PO reference and charged to OPS-INFRA. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/nimbus-inv-033.pdf

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: NimbusCloud INV-2026-11-033, amount $9,120, vendor_id=NC-771. No PO detected. AP ticket created: AP-8902. Recommended: HOLD until PO match or approval.

Ethan Moore: This looks like the nightly load tests for the recommendations engine on Nov 8-9. We had a dev agreement but didn't create a PO for the sandbox runs. Cost should code to ENG-Platform (GL 5602).

Nadia Silva: Procurement: we have an open PO PO-ENG-2026-035 with balance $20k that covers NimbusCloud. Ask vendor to reissue against that PO and correct G/L. If they refuse, request credit and re-bill.

Rina Kapoor: Sending vendor note now. Draft: "Per Redwood policy, invoices need a valid PO. Please reissue referencing PO-ENG-2026-035 or provide a credit memo so we can rebill under the active PO."

Ethan Moore: I'll attach usage logs: s3://redwood-logs/tests/recs/2026-11/11-08-09.csv showing 0.8TB usage vs vendor billed 1.6TB. Will add to AP-8902.

invoices-bot: AP-8902 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor offered partial credit of $4,560 and to re-bill remainder. Added note: escalate to finance-approvals if partial credit not acceptable.

Nadia Silva: Partial credit = disputed quantity. Procurement prefers full reissue to PO-ENG-2026-035. If vendor holds firm, route to VP Eng for exception approval to accept remainder without PO.

Rina Kapoor: Holding payment and marking invoice as disputed. If vendor doesn't reissue in 5 business days, escalate to Legal. Will update AP-8902 with vendor responses.

Ethan Moore: Thanks. I've uploaded the logs and CC'd Anika. Will follow up with vendor support for meter breakdown.
